decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a correlated N/E drop with partial recovery around indices 545–595, and (2) a coherent linear trend across all axes starting abruptly at index 725 through the end. Other intervals show typical noise or smooth motion without ambiguous superposed changes.

regions.observation: N/E/U show correlated multi-sample drop in N (~-3 to -5 MAD) and E (~-4 to -6 MAD) around index 550–570, with U rising slightly; the drop appears abrupt (2–3 samples) and is followed by a slow recovery in N/E but not full return, suggesting a possible offset or partial reversal. Surroundings show typical noise before and after.

From ~725 onward, all three components exhibit near-linear trends: N drops steadily from ~-1.5 to -2.0, E rises from ~-12.2 to ~-11.4, and U falls from ~1.8 to ~1.5 over just 5 samples—unusual coherence and slope for such short span, possibly indicating a transient platform or measurement artifact; the onset at 725 is abrupt and sustained through end.
